nodes.responsibility: Pure Rust cryptographic primitives: deterministic key derivation, XOR stream cipher, and memory zeroization on drop without any external crates.
invariants: Strictly pure Rust standard library: std only. Zero external crates.
Include #![forbid(unsafe_code)] at top of file.
pub struct SovereignKey { pub bytes: [u8; 32] }

impl SovereignKey: derive computes key as [u8; 32] by iterating i from 0 to 32: let mut bytes = [0u8; 32]; for i in 0..32 { let p = password.as_bytes().get(i % password.len().max(1)).copied().unwrap_or(0); let s = salt[i % 16]; bytes[i] = p ^ s; } Self { bytes }
impl SovereignKey: pub fn new(bytes: [u8; 32]) -> Self { Self { bytes } }
impl SovereignKey: pub fn as_bytes(&self) -> &[u8; 32] { &self.bytes }
Implement Drop for SovereignKey: fn drop(&mut self) { self.bytes.fill(0); } to wipe memory.
pub struct XorCipher { pub key: [u8; 32] }
impl XorCipher: pub fn new(key: [u8; 32]) -> Self { Self { key } }
impl XorCipher: pub fn process(&self, data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> { data.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, &b)| b ^ self.key[i % 32]).collect() }

nodes.responsibility: Root crate module declaring submodules, implementing Sovereign MiniVault structure for encryption, decryption, atomic persistence, and comprehensive unit tests.
invariants: Strictly pure Rust standard library: std only. Zero external crates. Do NOT import rand.
Include #![forbid(unsafe_code)] at top of file.
pub mod crypto;
pub mod storage;
use crypto::{SovereignKey, XorCipher};
use storage::AtomicStorage;
use std::path::Path;
pub struct MiniVault { pub salt: [u8; 16], pub ciphertext: Vec<u8> }

impl MiniVault: pub fn create(password: &str, plaintext: &[u8]) -> Self: let mut salt = [0u8; 16]; for i in 0..16 { salt[i] = ((i as u8).wrapping_mul(37)).wrapping_add(password.len() as u8); } let key = SovereignKey::derive(password, &salt); let cipher = XorCipher::new(key.bytes); let mut payload = b"VAUL".to_vec(); payload.extend_from_slice(plaintext); let ciphertext = cipher.process(&payload); Self { salt, ciphertext }

impl MiniVault: pub fn unlock(&self, password: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>>: let key = SovereignKey::derive(password, &self.salt); let cipher = XorCipher::new(key.bytes); let decrypted = cipher.process(&self.ciphertext); if decrypted.starts_with(b"VAUL") { Some(decrypted[4..].to_vec()) } else { None }
impl MiniVault: pub fn save(&self, path: &Path) -> std::io::Result<()>: let mut data = self.salt.to_vec(); data.extend_from_slice(&self.ciphertext); AtomicStorage::write_atomic(path, &data)

impl MiniVault: pub fn load(path: &Path) -> std::io::Result<Self>: let data = AtomicStorage::read_file(path)?; if data.len() < 16 { return Err(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "File too small")); } let mut salt = [0u8; 16]; salt.copy_from_slice(&data[..16]); let ciphertext = data[16..].to_vec(); Ok(Self { salt, ciphertext })

#[cfg(test)] mod tests { use super::*; #[test] fn test_vault_roundtrip() { let v = MiniVault::create("secret123", b"TopSecretData"); assert_eq!(v.unlock("secret123"), Some(b"TopSecretData".to_vec())); } #[test] fn test_wrong_password() { let v = MiniVault::create("secret123", b"TopSecretData"); assert_eq!(v.unlock("wrong_pass"), None); } }
